selection_note: Curated representative 2021 arXiv q-fin papers spanning portfolio optimization, reinforcement-learning trading, univariate/multicurrency volatility forecasting, and cross-sectional graph volatility forecasting. This is not a citation ranking.

papers.title: Deep learning for efficient frontier calculation in finance
papers.paper_claim: Deep neural-network formulations are proposed for Mean-Variance and Mean-CVaR efficient frontiers; a projected feedforward formulation is reported to handle global portfolio-weight constraints and outperform classical penalization in the paper's experiments.
papers.implementation_scope: Contract-level implementation of a projected long-only unit-budget portfolio-weight primitive. No neural-network training or paper figure/table reproduction.
papers.unreproduced_evidence: The paper's original experiment inputs, trained network states, and full numerical evaluation are not committed in this repository.

papers.title: High-Dimensional Stock Portfolio Trading with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.paper_claim: A Deep Q-learning portfolio method is evaluated out of sample on 48 US-stock portfolio setups from 10 to 500 stocks and is reported to outperform the considered passive and active benchmarks on average.
papers.implementation_scope: Exact deterministic implementation of the paper's stated invest-versus-cash reward contract, including entry transaction cost and cross-sectional mean cash reward. No DQN training.
papers.unreproduced_evidence: The paper's complete point-in-time stock universe, fundamentals, training states, validation checkpoint selection, and test trades are not committed in this repository.

papers.title: Forex Trading Volatility Prediction using Neural Network Models
papers.paper_claim: A multi-scale LSTM using multiple currency-pair inputs is reported to outperform autoregressive, GARCH, and other deep-learning baselines for Forex volatility prediction.
papers.implementation_scope: Deterministic multi-scale realized-variance feature construction with scale-consistency checks. No LSTM training or benchmark reproduction.
papers.unreproduced_evidence: The paper's Forex dataset, exact train/test tensors, fitted model weights, and baseline forecasts are not committed in this repository.

papers.title: Multivariate Realized Volatility Forecasting with Graph Neural Network
papers.paper_claim: A Graph Transformer Network is proposed to combine limit-order-book features with temporal and cross-sectional relations; experiments on about 500 S&P 500 stocks report better performance than the paper's benchmarks.
papers.implementation_scope: Deterministic weighted multi-relation graph aggregation with row normalization and permutation-equivariance checks. No Graph Transformer training or benchmark reproduction.
papers.unreproduced_evidence: The paper's limit-order-book dataset, relation tensors, training configuration, fitted model weights, and benchmark predictions are not committed in this repository.
